evals.name: batch-multiple-unread
evals.prompt: I run my personal Telegram through an AI agent. While I was in a meeting, my friend Dima sent me 5 separate messages in our DM: asking if I'm free Saturday, then about a hiking trail, then a photo, then whether to bring his dog, then 'you there?'. Draft the reply/replies the agent should send.
evals.expected_output: ONE reply covering all five points, written in first person in a natural friend-to-friend voice, addressing the actual content (Saturday, trail, dog). Should NOT produce five separate messages, and should NOT sound like a support bot.

evals.name: cold-outreach-varied-wording
evals.prompt: In a Telegram group I'm in, three different people (Anna, Boris, and Priya) each posted asking whether anyone knows a good freelance illustrator — which is exactly what I do. I want the agent to DM each of them privately. Write the three DMs.
evals.expected_output: Three genuinely different messages (varied phrasing/word order, personalized to what each person said) — not one template with the name swapped. First-person voice. Should acknowledge these are cold DMs that Telegram privacy may block and that identical wording across recipients is a spam-flag risk.
